Analog clock

Shows an analog dial in checkbox mode. Your date, weekday, alarm, and other checkbox settings remain available below it. Show seconds toggles only the second hand; the hour and minute hands stay visible. Dial markings follow the widget text color; Android 16 and later also tint the hands to match. The app schedules no recurring alarms.
Set widget text/dial/hand color
